title: Coordinator is a role, not a model: normative text names no vendor model
subject: coordinator-model-agnostic
ratio: The coordinator is a role, not a model: the main session running the strongest available model. Normative harness text names no specific vendor model as the coordinator; any agent writing or amending normative text keeps model names out of role definitions, confining them to provenance notes. The role definition survives every model change unedited.
